source: kenyanstocks.com financial statements API (farmed, complete) | CRON 20260930_141849: Operating Expenses populated from the file's own filed total row Operating And Administrative Expenses (3,084,932,000 FY2025 and 4,043,753,000 FY2024). The row was present but empty, and because the panel resolves the first matching alias it was rendering a dash over a filed figure. Filled 2026-10-01 from the kenyanstocks.com comprehensive income API: Income Tax FY2024 from the source line Income Tax Expense; Income Tax FY2025 from the source line Income Tax Expense; Gross Profit FY2024 from the source line Gross Profit derived as Revenue less Cost of Sales (Revenue - Cost of Sales); Gross Profit FY2025 from the source line Gross Profit derived as Revenue less Cost of Sales (Revenue - Cost of Sales); Cost of Sales FY2024 from the source line Cost Of Sales; Cost of Sales FY2025 from the source line Cost Of Sales. | CRON 20261014B: FY2026 (year ended 31 March 2026) column read from Centum Investment Company Plc 2026 Integrated Report and Financial Statements, consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income (Kshs thousands read as absolute KES): Revenues from contracts with customers 3,893,491; interest income 370,349; interest expense 54,192; net interest income 316,157; Total revenues 4,209,648; cost of sales 2,220,754; gross profit 1,988,894; change in fair value of investment property 4,085,667; other income 1,628,207; operating and administrative expenses 3,089,569; finance costs 2,193,710; profit before tax -642,969; income tax credit 1,386,884; profit for the year 743,915 (attributable to owners of the parent 1,304,509, non-controlling interests -560,594); Earnings per share basic and diluted 1.99. Gates tie: total revenues less cost of sales equals the printed gross profit 1,988,894, and profit before tax less the income tax credit equals the printed profit for the year 743,915. Revenue holds the printed Total revenues line so that revenue less cost of sales equals the printed gross profit; the stored FY2025 and FY2024 columns hold the revenues from contracts with customers line alone, so the revenue row is on a wider definition from FY2026 onward. Operating Profit (EBIT) follows the construction already used in this file, gross profit less operating expenses, which reproduces the stored FY2025 value exactly, and not the printed operating profit of 1,090,210, which includes the fair value gain on investment property and other income. EPS is a new row for this file: FY2026 1.99 and FY2025 2.05 are the printed basic and diluted figures from this same audited statement, and earlier years are left empty because no printed per share figure has been read for them. Ratios use the consolidated statement of financial position at 31 March 2026: total assets 82,125,284; total equity 43,552,893; total liabilities 38,309,473.
